newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Qilu Oil Shengli profit hits $112 mln.
newsitem.headline: China's Qilu Oil Shengli profit hits $112 mln.

text.p: Profit at Qilu Petrochemical Co's Shengli refinery reached 934 million yuan ($112 million) in 1996, the Worker's Daily said on Monday.
Profits of the refinery in the eastern province of Shandong exceeded the target for the year by more than 61 percent, or 345 million yuan, the newspaper said.
The newspaper did not say if the profits were before or after tax. Most Chinese firms give pre-tax figures.
The refinery's output of light oil increased by 256,000 tonnes last year, a rise that generated an extra 200 million yuan in profits, it said but gave no further details.
